description: Frozen 0.1 lint rules whose finding marks a malformed or ambiguous 0.1 source. A blocked upgrade source with such a finding is class (c) in the readiness report (carve#6163, carve#6164): it has no single 0.1 meaning to preserve.

rules.unclosed-code-fence: a code fence with no closer; 0.1 recovers by its own ownership rules
rules.unclosed-container-fence: a container fence with no closer
rules.unclosed-comment-fence: a comment fence with no closer
rules.unclosed-inline-emphasis: an emphasis opener that never closes
rules.block-opener-overindented: a block opener past its container's content column
rules.list-item-block-overindented: a list item block past the item's content column
rules.list-marker-below-content-column: a list marker below its owner's content column
rules.description-separator-below-content-colu: a description separator below its owner's content column
rules.list-item-body-detached: a list item body separated from its marker
rules.refused-continuation-marker: a continuation marker 0.1 refused (older rule id)
rules.table-span-marker-blocked: a table span marker 0.1 could not apply
rules.table-marker-run-padding: a table marker run with padding inside it
rules.table-shaped-paragraph: a table-shaped line 0.1 read as a paragraph
rules.unattached-block-attribute: a block attribute with no block to attach to
rules.block-marker-as-text: a block marker 0.1 read as text because the block never opened
rules.fence-opener-fallback: a fence opener 0.1 read through its fallback
rules.empty-link-destination: a link with an empty destination
rules.empty-reference-definition: a reference definition with no destination
rules.duplicate-footnote-definition: two definitions of one footnote label
